name: Rigo
description: A young leonin Broker solicitor in a pinstripe vest with a street network, who teleports Perrie to headquarters.

timeline.summary: Rigo finds Perrie in the alley and tells him to stand down and takes him to Nido Sanctuary by teleport.
timeline.quote: a flash of white light envelops them as Rigo teleports them off to their headquarters.

relations.quote: He turns around to look at the solicitor.
